entries.fr: Ce Mog soupire tristement en rêvassant.

entries.en: The unmaneuvering moogle has lost his nuts in an unfortunate encounter with a vinegaroon. As the moogle was traveling through Ohl Tahn, the bladed beast spotted him and gave chase. The terrified moogle escaped to Zenith unharmed, only to discover that he dropped his kupo nut collection along the way. He asks you to return to the scene of his disgrace and retrieve his five precious nuts.

entries.en: I've really gone and done it this time, kupo... I was merrily making my way through Ohl Tahn when a bladed vinegaroon started to chase me. I was so scared, I dropped my nuts!
entries.fr: J'ai perdu mes  à Ohl Tahn en m'enfuyant face à ces méchants vinaigriers à lames. J'en avais cinq, bien grosses, et maintenant, plus rien. Leur saveur exquise me manque déjà, kuppo...

entries.en: My nuts! My beautiful nuts! I'd recognize those kupo nuts anywhere, kupo! Thank you, adventurer─you're a lifesaver. Why, when I realized I'd lost my nuts, I was so upset I nearly pulled off my pom-pom!
entries.fr: Oh ! Ce sont bien elles ! Elles sont là toutes les cinq ! Je n'aurais plus aucun plaisir dans la vie sans ce délice. Je m'en arracherais le pompon de désespoir. Merci de tout cœur, kuppo !
entries.ja:

がない生活なんて、悲しみしかないくぽ。
絶望のあまり、自分のポンポンをむしるところだったくぽ！
